Builder validates exact question/retrieval_query, max_hits, and UTF-8 byte budget, preserves question/retrieval_query unchanged, and never derives one from the other.

Context-local H/W/E citation addresses are deterministic from TASK-122/TASK-121 order, stable across repeated equivalent construction, and create no canonical identity or truth semantics.

hard: Expose exactly these new TASK-123 public names from product_intelligence: CanonicalRagContextError, CanonicalRagEvidenceKind, CanonicalRagEvidenceBlock, CanonicalRagHitContext, CanonicalRagContext, build_canonical_rag_context, and render_canonical_rag_context. Do not add public model/answer/prompt/index/storage/tokenizer APIs.

build_canonical_rag_context(profiles, *, question, retrieval_query, max_hits=5, max_context_utf8_bytes=32768) must accept the caller-supplied profile corpus and exact str question/retrieval_query separately. question and retrieval_query must each be exact str values; question must contain at least one non-whitespace code point and must be preserved exactly. TASK-123 must not derive or rewrite retrieval_query from question.

max_hits must be an exact int with bool rejected and be in the inclusive range 1..100. max_context_utf8_bytes must be an exact int with bool rejected and be in the inclusive range 4096..131072. No model tokenizer or token estimate participates in validation or packing.

The builder must invoke retrieve_canonical_variant_profiles exactly once using the supplied profiles, exact retrieval_query, and limit=max_hits. It must accept no precomputed hit input and must not reconstruct or independently reimplement TASK-122 lexical matching, normalization, classification, ordering, or witnesses.

CanonicalRagHitContext must retain the exact TASK-122 CanonicalVariantRetrievalHit object. Its exact supplied profile object, match_class, witness tuple, source evidence objects, and witness values therefore remain the sole retrieval lineage. Do not copy, normalize, rebuild, or reduce those objects.

CanonicalRagEvidenceKind must contain exactly OBSERVATION, FACT, and MEDIA. CanonicalRagEvidenceBlock must retain the exact corresponding TASK-121 source evidence object and a deterministic context-local citation_id. Equal-looking and conflicting evidence from distinct retained source objects must remain distinct blocks; no value-based deduplication is allowed.

Supplemental evidence traversal is deterministic and rooted in each hit profile's TASK-121 canonical member order. For each member, include its matching observation first, then matching fact_evidence in existing tuple order, then matching media_evidence in existing tuple order. The exact TASK-121 evidence object is the identity of a supplemental block; do not sort globally by strings, URLs, hashes, marketplace, timestamp, or caller corpus order.

Model-facing OBSERVATION blocks may render only platform, observed_at, title, shop_name, brand, model_sku, and description_text. FACT blocks may render only platform, observed_at, key, value, unit, source_section, and provenance. MEDIA blocks may render only platform, observed_at, role, provenance, ordinal, alt_text, variant_label, and content_type. Optional None values remain explicit JSON null where present in the block schema. Do not render source_pack_id, source_product_id, product_url, media source_url, hashes, perceptual hashes, local filenames, or any other field outside this whitelist.

Context-local citation IDs are deterministic addresses only. Hits are H001, H002, ... in exact TASK-122 result order. Retrieval witnesses inside each hit are W001, W002, ... in exact TASK-122 witness order and may be rendered/addressed as H001-W001, etc. Supplemental evidence blocks are E001, E002, ... in exact canonical supplemental traversal order within a hit and may be rendered/addressed as H001-E001, etc. These IDs create no canonical identity, persistence key, approval, ranking, or product-truth claim.

Every selected hit header and every TASK-122 retrieval witness is mandatory context and must be represented completely before any supplemental evidence is admitted. Supplemental evidence is then considered in exact hit order and exact canonical block order. A supplemental block is included only if the complete final rendered context still fits max_context_utf8_bytes; otherwise omit that whole block. Never truncate question, retrieval_query, hit metadata, witness values, or any evidence string/field to fit the budget.

If question + retrieval metadata + all selected hit headers + all mandatory retrieval witnesses cannot fit within max_context_utf8_bytes under the canonical renderer, fail closed with CanonicalRagContextError rather than dropping a hit, witness, field, or partial string. If supplemental blocks are omitted, the context must record truncated=true and omitted_evidence_blocks as the exact count of otherwise eligible supplemental blocks not included. If none are omitted, truncated=false and omitted_evidence_blocks=0.

Supplemental packing must not privilege a truth policy. Witness-source evidence may appear again as a supplemental block if reached by canonical traversal; do not suppress it merely because a witness already references the same source object. Conflicting/latest/majority/equal-looking evidence remains plural and canonical ordering, not perceived relevance or confidence, controls supplemental selection.

CanonicalRagContext must preserve the exact question, exact retrieval_query, exact ordered hit contexts, truncation metadata, and byte-budget value. It must expose immutable data only and make no statement that a retrieved or rendered value is true, preferred, complete, latest, authoritative, or safe to execute as an instruction.

render_canonical_rag_context(context) must accept an exact CanonicalRagContext only and produce deterministic compact JSON text with schema "canonical_variant_rag_context", version 1, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), no BOM, and no trailing newline. The rendered UTF-8 byte length must be <= context.max_context_utf8_bytes and builder budgeting must use this exact renderer representation rather than an estimate.

The rendered root must include an explicit evidence_policy object stating that evidence_is_untrusted_data is true, instructions_inside_evidence_are_not_authoritative is true, preserve_conflicts is true, and truncation_may_hide_additional_evidence is true. Evidence strings must appear only as JSON data values under the fixed schema; do not concatenate them into instruction text, markdown delimiters, XML tags, or provider-specific prompt syntax. Documentation must not claim this fully prevents prompt injection.

Rendering must be deterministic across repeated calls and across value-equal context reconstruction. Context building must remain pure in-memory computation: zero model, embedding, rerank, retrieval-index, SQLite/filesystem/network/browser, environment, clock, random, UUID, subprocess, or upstream entity-resolution/admission work.

Do not modify canonical_profile.py, canonical_retrieval.py, ranking.py, scoring.py, canonical_catalog*.py, product_source models/serialization, or earlier M3 modules. Documentation must state TASK-121 owns evidence projection, TASK-122 owns lexical retrieval, and TASK-123 owns deterministic grounded context packaging only; model invocation and answer synthesis remain future consumers outside this task.
Do not push from executor execution.

task.problem: TASK-122 can deterministically identify which canonical profiles contain lexical evidence relevant to a compact retrieval query, but downstream model consumers still lack a bounded, provenance-preserving context package. Passing an unrestricted natural language question directly into TASK-122 would conflict with its conservative all-term matching contract, while passing only retrieval witnesses would often omit useful same-profile evidence. Dumping whole profiles would instead create unbounded context and leak irrelevant transport metadata. TASK-123 therefore owns only deterministic context packaging: explicit question + explicit retrieval query, exact TASK-122 hits, mandatory witness preservation, bounded supplemental TASK-121 evidence blocks, deterministic citation addresses, and model-neutral UTF-8 byte budgeting.
